pretreatments.description: Air-drying of corn stover to a moisture content less than 10%.
Grinding of air-dried corn stover to pass through a 5 mm sieve.
Solid-state alkaline pretreatment with NaOH solution (0.25 M) for 24 hours. Mixing of 200g corn stover with 200ml NaOH solution (1.0% w/w loading).
Solid-state alkaline pretreatment with NaOH solution (0.625 M) for 24 hours. Mixing of 200g corn stover with 200ml NaOH solution (2.5% w/w loading).
Solid-state alkaline pretreatment with NaOH solution (1.25 M) for 24 hours. Mixing of 200g corn stover with 200ml NaOH solution (5.0% w/w loading).
Solid-state alkaline pretreatment with NaOH solution (1.85 M) for 24 hours. Mixing of 200g corn stover with 200ml NaOH solution (7.5% w/w loading).
Solid-state anaerobic digestion of pretreated corn stover in SS-AD reactor with effluent of liquid AD as inoculum and nitrogen source. Digestion conditions: 37 °C for 40 days.
Concurrent NaOH pretreatment and anaerobic digestion with simultaneous feeding of pretreated corn stover and effluent into SS-AD reactor. Digestion conditions: 37 °C for 40 days.
Concurrent NaOH pretreatment and anaerobic digestion with simultaneous feeding of pretreated corn stover and effluent into SS-AD reactor. Digestion conditions: 37 °C for 40 days.
Concurrent NaOH pretreatment and anaerobic digestion with simultaneous feeding of pretreated corn stover and effluent into SS-AD reactor. Digestion conditions: 37 °C for 40 days.
